name: morrow
purpose: A fictional product brand used in Airveek examples so viewers can see how a consistent brand system appears across product imagery.

logo.alt: morrow fictional demo brand logo with two sparkle stars
logo.placement: Apply the supplied mark naturally to a product label, package, or product surface; never use it as an Airveek watermark.

usageRules: MORROW is fictional and must never be presented as a real customer, retailer, or trademarked product.
Use only the supplied logo asset as the brand reference; do not redraw or invent alternate marks.
Keep the exact lowercase wordmark morrow and both sparkle stars when the model renders a product label.
Do not add other readable copy, claims, competing brands, watermarks, or retailer logos.
Marketplace-safe variants may omit the mark only when a platform policy requires an unbranded main image; the demo brand variant remains available for owned-site examples.
